title: Rosalind and the Garden
author: Mirabel Sterling
blurb: Casper Coldharbour, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
